For `undo()`:
```java
public void undo()
{
  if (getUndoQuota() == 0) {
    return;
  }
  if (getHistory().isEmpty()) {
    return;
  }
  GameStateTransition last = getHistory().pop();
  GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
  for (Entry<Position, Position> entry : reversed.getMoves().entrySet()) {
    Position to = entry.getKey();
    Position from = entry.getValue();
    Entity entity = getEntities().get(to);
    getEntities().put(to, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
    getEntities().put(from, entity);
  }
  setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
  if (getUndoQuota() > 0) {
    setUndoQuota(getUndoQuota() - 1);
  }
}
```

public EList<Position> getAllPlayerPositions()
{
  List<Entry<Integer, Position>> players = new ArrayList<Entry<Integer, Position>>();
  for (Entry<Position, Entity> entry : getEntities().entrySet()) {
    Entity ent = entry.getValue();
    if (ent instanceof Player) {
      players.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<Integer, Position>(((Player) ent).getId(), entry.getKey()));
    }
  }
  players.sort(new Comparator<Entry<Integer, Position>>() {
    public int compare(Entry<Integer, Position> a, Entry<Integer, Position> b) {
      return Integer.compare(a.getKey(), b.getKey());
    }
  });
  EList<Position> result = new BasicEList<Position>();
  for (Entry<Integer, Position> p : players) {
    result.add(p.getValue());
  }
  return result;
}

```java
public EList<Position> getAllPlayerPositions()
{
  List<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>> players = new ArrayList<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>>();
  for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : getEntities().entrySet())
  {
    Entity ent = entry.getValue();
    if (ent instanceof Player)
    {
      players.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<Integer, Position>(((Player) ent).getId(), entry.getKey()));
    }
  }
  java.util.Collections.sort(players, new Comparator<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>>()
  {
    public int compare(Map.Entry<Integer, Position> a, Map.Entry<Integer, Position> b)
    {
      return Integer.compare(a.getKey(), b.getKey());
    }
  });
  EList<Position> result = new BasicEList<Position>();
  for (Map.Entry<Integer, Position> p : players)
  {
    result.add(p.getValue());
  }
  return result;
}

   * Summary:
   *   Atomically relocates whatever Entity currently sits at `from` to `to`,
   *   leaving the source cell as Empty, and records the move inside the
   *   current GameStateTransition so it can be undone later. This is the
   *   primitive used both for a player walking and for a player pushing a
   *   box (the push issues two moves: player and box).
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Look up entity = entities.getEntity(from). It must not be Empty/Wall.
   *   2. If entities.getEntity(to) is not Empty and not the same entity being
   *      moved (used during push: the box), the move is invalid; abort.
   *   3. entities.putEntity(from, new Empty());

  public void move(final Position from, final Position to)
  {
    Entity entity = getEntities().get(from);
    if (entity instanceof Empty || entity instanceof Wall)
    {
      return;
    }
    Entity destEntity = getEntities().get(to);
    if (!(destEntity instanceof Empty) && destEntity != entity)
    {
      return;
    }
    getEntities().put(from, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
    getEntities().put(to, entity);
    if (getCurrentTransition() != null)
    {
      getCurrentTransition().add(from, to);
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Reverts the game state to the most recent checkpoint by popping the
   *   top GameStateTransition off the history stack and applying its
   *   reverse() atomically. A finite undo quota is decremented only when a
   *   checkpoint was actually consumed.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If undoQuota == 0, do nothing (undo is not allowed when quota is 0).
   *   2. If history is empty, do nothing (quota is not consumed).
   *   3. GameStateTransition last = history.pop();
   *   4. GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
   *   5. For each (to, from) in reversed.moves:
   *        entities.putEntity(to, new Empty());
   *        entities.putEntity(from, entityRecordedInReversedMove);
   *   6. currentTransition = new GameStateTransition();
   *   7. If undoQuota == -1 (unlimited), keep it; else if undoQuota > 0,
   *      decrement by 1.
   * Related Features:
   *   - GameState.history
   *   - GameState.currentTransition (reset to empty)

   *     is a no-op and the quota is not consumed.

  public void undo()
  {
    if (getUndoQuota() == 0)
    {
      return;
    }
    if (getHistory().isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }
    GameStateTransition last = getHistory().pop();
    GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Position> entry : reversed.getMoves().entrySet())
    {
      Position toPos = entry.getKey();
      Position fromPos = entry.getValue();
      Entity entity = getEntities().get(toPos);
      getEntities().put(toPos, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
      getEntities().put(fromPos, entity);
    }
    setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
    if (getUndoQuota() > 0)
    {
      setUndoQuota(getUndoQuota() - 1);
    }
  }

      if (ent instanceof Player)

      {
        return Integer.compare(a.getKey(), b.getKey());

    });
    EList<Position> result = new BasicEList<Position>();
    for (Map.Entry<Integer, Position> p : players)

      result.add(p.getValue());
    }
    return result;

In `reversed.moves`, the entry is `(to, from)`. So `to` is the first element, `from` is the second. In `Map.Entry`, `getKey()` returns the first element and `getValue()` returns the second.

So:
- `entry.getKey()` = `to` (the destination in the reversed move)
- `entry.getValue()` = `from` (the source in the reversed move)

And the operation is:
- `entities.putEntity(to, new Empty())` - put Empty at `to` (the destination in reversed)
- `entities.putEntity(from, entityRecordedInReversedMove)` - put the entity at `from` (the source in reversed)

So in the reversed direction, we move the entity from `to` back to `from`. The entityRecordedInReversedMove is the entity that was at `to` (in the reversed view, which is the destination in the reversed move). We capture it BEFORE putting Empty there.

Now, one more thought: the entity at `toPos` should be the entity that was recorded in the (original) move. But the entity is captured at the current state, not from the transition. So this only works correctly if the state hasn't been modified since the move was recorded.

In a normal undo flow:
1. Move: state updated, transition recorded.
2. Maybe more moves.
3. Checkpoint: transition pushed to history.
4. Undo: pop transition, reverse, apply reverse to state.

Between step 1 and step 4, the state may have been modified by subsequent moves. So when we undo, the entity at `toPos` (in the reversed map) might not be the same as what was originally moved there.

For example:
- Original move: move(player, A, A+1). State: A=empty, A+1=player. Transition: {A -> A+1}.
- Subsequent move: move(player, A+1, A+2). State: A+1=empty, A+2=player. Transition: {A -> A+1, A+1 -> A+2}.
- Checkpoint. History has {A -> A+1, A+1 -> A+2}.
- Undo. Pop, reverse: {(A+2, A+1), (A+1, A)} where key=to, value=from. So entries are: (A+2, A+1) and (A+1, A).
  - Process (A+2, A+1): entity at A+2 is player. Put empty at A+2, put player at A+1. State: A=empty, A+1=player, A+2=empty.
  - Process (A+1, A): entity at A+1 is player. Put empty at A+1, put player at A. State: A=player, A+1=empty, A+2=empty. ✓

OK this works because we process in order. The iteration order of the reversed map matters.

If the original transition was {A -> A+1, A+1 -> A+2}, the reversed would be... well, it depends on the `reverse()` implementation. If `reverse()` just iterates the original and adds entries in the same order, the reversed map has keys {A+1, A+2}. Iterating gives A+1, A+2 (or A+2, A+1 depending on Map type).

If the iteration is in insertion order (LinkedHashMap-like):
- Iter 1: (A+1, A). Entity at A+1 is player. Put empty at A+1, put player at A. State: A=player, A+1=empty, A+2=player. Then iter 2: (A+2, A+1). Entity at A+2 is player. Put empty at A+2, put player at A+1. State: A=player, A+1=player, A+2=empty. ✗ WRONG.

If the iteration is in reverse insertion order:
- Iter 1: (A+2, A+1). Entity at A+2 is player. Put empty at A+2, put player at A+1. State: A=empty, A+1=player, A+2=empty. Then iter 2: (A+1, A). Entity at A+1 is player. Put empty at A+1, put player at A. State: A=player, A+1=empty, A+2=empty. ✓ CORRECT.

```java
public EList<Position> getAllPlayerPositions()
{
  List<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>> players = new ArrayList<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>>();
  for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : getEntities().entrySet())
  {
    Entity ent = entry.getValue();
    if (ent instanceof Player)
    {
      players.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<Integer, Position>(((Player) ent).getId(), entry.getKey()));
    }
  }
  players.sort(new Comparator<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>>()
  {
    public int compare(Map.Entry<Integer, Position> a, Map.Entry<Integer, Position> b)
    {
      return Integer.compare(a.getKey(), b.getKey());
    }
  });
  EList<Position> result = new BasicEList<Position>();
  for (Map.Entry<Integer, Position> p : players)
  {
    result.add(p.getValue());
  }
  return result;
}
```

  public void move(final Position from, final Position to)
  {
    Entity entity = getEntities().get(from);
    if (entity instanceof Empty || entity instanceof Wall)
    {
      return;
    }
    Entity destEntity = getEntities().get(to);
    if (!(destEntity instanceof Empty) && destEntity != entity)
    {
      return;
    }
    getEntities().put(from, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
    getEntities().put(to, entity);
    if (getCurrentTransition() != null)
    {
      getCurrentTransition().add(from, to);
    }
  }

   *   Reverts the game state to the most recent checkpoint by popping the

   * Algorithm:

      return;
    }
    if (getHistory().isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }
    GameStateTransition last = getHistory().pop();
    GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Position> entry : reversed.getMoves().entrySet())
    {
      Position toPos = entry.getKey();
      Position fromPos = entry.getValue();
      Entity entity = getEntities().get(toPos);
      getEntities().put(toPos, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
      getEntities().put(fromPos, entity);

    setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
    if (getUndoQuota() > 0)
    {
      setUndoQuota(getUndoQuota() - 1);
    }

```java
public void move(final Position from, final Position to)
{
  Entity entity = getEntities().get(from);
  if (entity instanceof Empty || entity instanceof Wall) {
    return;  // invalid
  }
  Entity destEntity = getEntities().get(to);
  if (!(destEntity instanceof Empty) && destEntity != entity) {
    return;  // invalid
  }
  getEntities().put(from, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
  getEntities().put(to, entity);
  if (getCurrentTransition() != null) {
    getCurrentTransition().add(from, to);
  }
}
```

Wait, the docstring says "It must not be Empty/Wall" for the `from` entity - so we return if entity is Empty or Wall. The check for `to` is "if not Empty and not the same entity being moved, abort". Both checks cause "abort" (return without action).

**`checkpoint()`**:
```java
public void checkpoint()
{
  if (getCurrentTransition() != null && !getCurrentTransition().getMoves().isEmpty()) {
    getHistory().push(getCurrentTransition());
    setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
  }
}
```

**`undo()`**:
```java
public void undo()
{
  if (getUndoQuota() == 0) return;
  if (getHistory().isEmpty()) return;
  GameStateTransition last = getHistory().pop();
  GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
  for (Entry<Position, Position> e : reversed.getMoves().entrySet()) {
    Position to = e.getKey();
    Position from = e.getValue();
    Entity entity = getEntities().get(to);
    getEntities().put(to, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
    getEntities().put(from, entity);
  }
  setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
  if (getUndoQuota() > 0) {
    setUndoQuota(getUndoQuota() - 1);
  }
}
```

**`isWin()`**:
```java
public boolean isWin()
{
  for (Position dest : getDestinations()) {
    Entity e = getEntities().get(dest);
    if (!(e instanceof Box)) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}
```

**`getPlayerPositionById(int id)`**:

public Position getPlayerPositionById(final int id)
{
  for (Entry<Position, Entity> e : getEntities().entrySet()) {
    Entity ent = e.getValue();
    if (ent instanceof Player && ((Player) ent).getId() == id) {
      return e.getKey();
    }
  }
  return null;
}

    }
  });

  }

```java
public void move(final Position from, final Position to)
{
  Entity entity = getEntities().get(from);
  if (entity instanceof Empty || entity instanceof Wall) {
    return;
  }
  Entity destEntity = getEntities().get(to);
  if (!(destEntity instanceof Empty) && destEntity != entity) {
    return;
  }
  getEntities().put(from, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
  getEntities().put(to, entity);
  if (getCurrentTransition() != null) {
    getCurrentTransition().add(from, to);
  }
}

public void checkpoint()
{

    getHistory().push(getCurrentTransition());
    setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
  }

For `undo()`:
```java
public void undo()
{
  if (getUndoQuota() == 0) {
    return;
  }
  if (getHistory().isEmpty()) {
    return;
  }
  GameStateTransition last = getHistory().pop();
  GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
  for (Entry<Position, Position> entry : reversed.getMoves().entrySet()) {
    Position to = entry.getKey();
    Position from = entry.getValue();
    Entity entity = getEntities().get(to);
    getEntities().put(to, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
    getEntities().put(from, entity);
  }
  setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
  if (getUndoQuota() > 0) {
    setUndoQuota(getUndoQuota() - 1);
  }
}
```

public boolean isWin()
{
  for (Position dest : getDestinations()) {
    Entity e = getEntities().get(dest);
    if (!(e instanceof Box)) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

public EList<Position> getAllPlayerPositions()
{
  List<Entry<Integer, Position>> players = new ArrayList<Entry<Integer, Position>>();
  for (Entry<Position, Entity> entry : getEntities().entrySet()) {
    Entity ent = entry.getValue();
    if (ent instanceof Player) {
      players.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<Integer, Position>(((Player) ent).getId(), entry.getKey()));
    }
  }
  players.sort(new Comparator<Entry<Integer, Position>>() {
    public int compare(Entry<Integer, Position> a, Entry<Integer, Position> b) {
      return Integer.compare(a.getKey(), b.getKey());
    }
  });
  EList<Position> result = new BasicEList<Position>();
  for (Entry<Integer, Position> p : players) {
    result.add(p.getValue());
  }
  return result;
}

public void move(final Position from, final Position to)
{

```java
public EList<Position> getAllPlayerPositions()
{
  List<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>> players = new ArrayList<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>>();
  for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : getEntities().entrySet())
  {
    Entity ent = entry.getValue();
    if (ent instanceof Player)
    {
      players.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<Integer, Position>(((Player) ent).getId(), entry.getKey()));
    }
  }
  java.util.Collections.sort(players, new Comparator<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>>()
  {
    public int compare(Map.Entry<Integer, Position> a, Map.Entry<Integer, Position> b)
    {
      return Integer.compare(a.getKey(), b.getKey());
    }
  });
  EList<Position> result = new BasicEList<Position>();
  for (Map.Entry<Integer, Position> p : players)
  {
    result.add(p.getValue());
  }
  return result;
}
```

   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Atomically relocates whatever Entity currently sits at `from` to `to`,
   *   leaving the source cell as Empty, and records the move inside the
   *   current GameStateTransition so it can be undone later. This is the
   *   primitive used both for a player walking and for a player pushing a
   *   box (the push issues two moves: player and box).
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Look up entity = entities.getEntity(from). It must not be Empty/Wall.
   *   2. If entities.getEntity(to) is not Empty and not the same entity being
   *      moved (used during push: the box), the move is invalid; abort.
   *   3. entities.putEntity(from, new Empty());
   *      entities.putEntity(to, entity);
   *   4. currentTransition.add(from, to);   // record the swap
   * Related Features:
   *   - GameState.entities
   *   - GameState.currentTransition
   * Related Classes:
   *   Related Classes: EntityMap, Entity, Empty, Box, Player, Position,
   *   GameStateTransition
   * Input:
   *   - from : Position
   *       The source cell currently containing the entity to move. Must be
   *       non-null and within bounds, and must contain a movable entity
   *       (Player or Box).
   *   - to   : Position
   *       The destination cell. Must be non-null, within bounds, and either
   *       Empty or - in the case of pushing a box - already logically emptied
   *       by the calling code.
   * Output:
   *   - void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - from and to are valid in-bounds positions.
   *   - from contains a movable entity (Player or Box).
   *   - to is Empty (for a player move) or will be the trailing cell beyond a
   *     box that is also being moved in the same transition.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - entities reflects the move: from is Empty, to holds the relocated
   *     entity.
   *   - currentTransition.moves records (from -> to) so undo() can revert it.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void move(final Position from, final Position to)
  {
    Entity entity = getEntities().get(from);
    if (entity instanceof Empty || entity instanceof Wall)
    {
      return;
    }
    Entity destEntity = getEntities().get(to);
    if (!(destEntity instanceof Empty) && destEntity != entity)
    {
      return;
    }
    getEntities().put(from, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
    getEntities().put(to, entity);
    if (getCurrentTransition() != null)
    {
      getCurrentTransition().add(from, to);
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Snapshots the current GameStateTransition onto the history stack so it
   *   can be reverted to later by undo(). A checkpoint is recorded when a
   *   box is successfully pushed (the caller, e.g. processAction, invokes
   *   this method at that point). Quota-consuming undos only occur when a
   *   checkpoint exists in history.
   * Algorithm:
   *   if (currentTransition != null && !currentTransition.moves.isEmpty()) {
   *       history.push(currentTransition);
   *       currentTransition = new GameStateTransition();
   *   }
   * Related Features:
   *   - GameState.history (TransitionStack accumulating checkpoints)
   *   - GameState.currentTransition (in-progress transition buffer)
   * Related Classes:
   *   Related Classes: GameStateTransition, TransitionStack
   * Input:
   *   - (none)
   * Output:
   *   - void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - currentTransition holds at least one recorded move (otherwise nothing
   *     is pushed; this avoids creating empty checkpoint entries).
   *   - The caller has determined that a box was successfully pushed in the
   *     current move sequence.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - Either history grows by one entry and currentTransition is replaced
   *     with a fresh empty transition, or nothing changes.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void checkpoint()
  {
    if (getCurrentTransition() != null && !getCurrentTransition().getMoves().isEmpty())
    {
      getHistory().push(getCurrentTransition());
      setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Reverts the game state to the most recent checkpoint by popping the
   *   top GameStateTransition off the history stack and applying its
   *   reverse() atomically. A finite undo quota is decremented only when a
   *   checkpoint was actually consumed.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If undoQuota == 0, do nothing (undo is not allowed when quota is 0).
   *   2. If history is empty, do nothing (quota is not consumed).
   *   3. GameStateTransition last = history.pop();
   *   4. GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
   *   5. For each (to, from) in reversed.moves:
   *        entities.putEntity(to, new Empty());
   *        entities.putEntity(from, entityRecordedInReversedMove);
   *   6. currentTransition = new GameStateTransition();
   *   7. If undoQuota == -1 (unlimited), keep it; else if undoQuota > 0,
   *      decrement by 1.
   * Related Features:
   *   - GameState.history
   *   - GameState.currentTransition (reset to empty)
   *   - GameState.undoQuota
   *   - GameState.entities (mutated to reflect the undo)
   * Related Classes:
   *   Related Classes: GameStateTransition, TransitionStack, EntityMap, Empty
   * Input:
   *   - (none)
   * Output:
   *   - void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - undoQuota != 0 (the caller guards against invoking undo() when the
   *     quota is exhausted).
   *   - history contains at least one checkpoint transition, otherwise undo() 
   *     is a no-op and the quota is not consumed.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - All entity positions recorded in the popped transition are restored
   *     to their pre-move locations.
   *   - undoQuota is decremented by 1 if it was a positive finite value;
   *     unchanged if it was -1 (unlimited).
   *   - currentTransition is replaced with a fresh empty transition.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void undo()
  {
    if (getUndoQuota() == 0)
    {
      return;
    }
    if (getHistory().isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }
    GameStateTransition last = getHistory().pop();
    GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Position> entry : reversed.getMoves().entrySet())
    {
      Position toPos = entry.getKey();
      Position fromPos = entry.getValue();
      Entity entity = getEntities().get(toPos);
      getEntities().put(toPos, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
      getEntities().put(fromPos, entity);
    }
    setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
    if (getUndoQuota() > 0)
    {
      setUndoQuota(getUndoQuota() - 1);
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Tests whether every destination Position on the board is currently
   *   occupied by a Box. If so, the game is won and the main loop should
   *   terminate.
   * Algorithm:
   *   for (Position dest : destinations) {
   *       Entity e = entities.getEntity(dest);
   *       if (!(e instanceof Box)) {

   * Pre-condition:

   */
  public boolean isWin()

      Entity e = getEntities().get(dest);

      {

      }
    }

  }

  /**

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Returns the current grid positions of every Player on the board, in
   *   ascending order of player ID.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Iterate over entities.
   *   2. For each cell, if the entity is a Player, record its Position
   *      together with the player's id.
   *   3. Sort the collected entries by player id (ascending) and return the
   *      Positions in that order.
   * Related Features:
   *   - GameState.entities (source of player locations)
   * Related Classes:
   *   Related Classes: Position, Player
   * Input:
   *   - (none)
   * Output:
   *   - List<Position> : one Position per active player, in ascending player
   *     ID order. Empty if the game has no players (which should not occur in
   *     a valid game).
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The state has been initialized from a valid map containing at least
   *     one player.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - The returned list is a fresh snapshot; GameState is not modified.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model kind="operation"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public EList<Position> getAllPlayerPositions()
  {
    List<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>> players = new ArrayList<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>>();
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : getEntities().entrySet())
    {
      Entity ent = entry.getValue();
      if (ent instanceof Player)
      {
        players.add(new AbstractMap.SimpleEntry<Integer, Position>(((Player) ent).getId(), entry.getKey()));
      }
    }
    players.sort(new Comparator<Map.Entry<Integer, Position>>()
    {
      public int compare(Map.Entry<Integer, Position> a, Map.Entry<Integer, Position> b)
      {
        return Integer.compare(a.getKey(), b.getKey());
      }
    });
    EList<Position> result = new BasicEList<Position>();
    for (Map.Entry<Integer, Position> p : players)
    {
      result.add(p.getValue());
    }
    return result;
  }

Now, one more thought: the entity at `toPos` should be the entity that was recorded in the (original) move. But the entity is captured at the current state, not from the transition. So this only works correctly if the state hasn't been modified since the move was recorded.

In a normal undo flow:
1. Move: state updated, transition recorded.
2. Maybe more moves.
3. Checkpoint: transition pushed to history.
4. Undo: pop transition, reverse, apply reverse to state.

Between step 1 and step 4, the state may have been modified by subsequent moves. So when we undo, the entity at `toPos` (in the reversed map) might not be the same as what was originally moved there.

For example:
- Original move: move(player, A, A+1). State: A=empty, A+1=player. Transition: {A -> A+1}.
- Subsequent move: move(player, A+1, A+2). State: A+1=empty, A+2=player. Transition: {A -> A+1, A+1 -> A+2}.
- Checkpoint. History has {A -> A+1, A+1 -> A+2}.
- Undo. Pop, reverse: {(A+2, A+1), (A+1, A)} where key=to, value=from. So entries are: (A+2, A+1) and (A+1, A).
  - Process (A+2, A+1): entity at A+2 is player. Put empty at A+2, put player at A+1. State: A=empty, A+1=player, A+2=empty.
  - Process (A+1, A): entity at A+1 is player. Put empty at A+1, put player at A. State: A=player, A+1=empty, A+2=empty. ✓

OK this works because we process in order. The iteration order of the reversed map matters.

If the original transition was {A -> A+1, A+1 -> A+2}, the reversed would be... well, it depends on the `reverse()` implementation. If `reverse()` just iterates the original and adds entries in the same order, the reversed map has keys {A+1, A+2}. Iterating gives A+1, A+2 (or A+2, A+1 depending on Map type).

If the iteration is in insertion order (LinkedHashMap-like):
- Iter 1: (A+1, A). Entity at A+1 is player. Put empty at A+1, put player at A. State: A=player, A+1=empty, A+2=player. Then iter 2: (A+2, A+1). Entity at A+2 is player. Put empty at A+2, put player at A+1. State: A=player, A+1=player, A+2=empty. ✗ WRONG.

If the iteration is in reverse insertion order:
- Iter 1: (A+2, A+1). Entity at A+2 is player. Put empty at A+2, put player at A+1. State: A=empty, A+1=player, A+2=empty. Then iter 2: (A+1, A). Entity at A+1 is player. Put empty at A+1, put player at A. State: A=player, A+1=empty, A+2=empty. ✓ CORRECT.

So the order of iteration matters. Without knowing the implementation of `reverse()`, I can't be sure. But the spec just says "For each (to, from) in reversed.moves", so we iterate in the natural order of the map.

   * Summary:
   *   Atomically relocates whatever Entity currently sits at `from` to `to`,
   *   leaving the source cell as Empty, and records the move inside the
   *   current GameStateTransition so it can be undone later. This is the
   *   primitive used both for a player walking and for a player pushing a
   *   box (the push issues two moves: player and box).
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Look up entity = entities.getEntity(from). It must not be Empty/Wall.
   *   2. If entities.getEntity(to) is not Empty and not the same entity being
   *      moved (used during push: the box), the move is invalid; abort.
   *   3. entities.putEntity(from, new Empty());
   *      entities.putEntity(to, entity);
   *   4. currentTransition.add(from, to);   // record the swap
   * Related Features:
   *   - GameState.entities
   *   - GameState.currentTransition
   * Related Classes:
   *   Related Classes: EntityMap, Entity, Empty, Box, Player, Position,
   *   GameStateTransition
   * Input:
   *   - from : Position
   *       The source cell currently containing the entity to move. Must be
   *       non-null and within bounds, and must contain a movable entity
   *       (Player or Box).
   *   - to   : Position
   *       The destination cell. Must be non-null, within bounds, and either
   *       Empty or - in the case of pushing a box - already logically emptied
   *       by the calling code.
   * Output:
   *   - void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - from and to are valid in-bounds positions.
   *   - from contains a movable entity (Player or Box).
   *   - to is Empty (for a player move) or will be the trailing cell beyond a
   *     box that is also being moved in the same transition.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - entities reflects the move: from is Empty, to holds the relocated
   *     entity.
   *   - currentTransition.moves records (from -> to) so undo() can revert it.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void move(final Position from, final Position to)
  {
    Entity entity = getEntities().get(from);
    if (entity instanceof Empty || entity instanceof Wall)
    {
      return;
    }
    Entity destEntity = getEntities().get(to);
    if (!(destEntity instanceof Empty) && destEntity != entity)
    {
      return;
    }
    getEntities().put(from, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
    getEntities().put(to, entity);
    if (getCurrentTransition() != null)
    {
      getCurrentTransition().add(from, to);
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Reverts the game state to the most recent checkpoint by popping the
   *   top GameStateTransition off the history stack and applying its
   *   reverse() atomically. A finite undo quota is decremented only when a
   *   checkpoint was actually consumed.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If undoQuota == 0, do nothing (undo is not allowed when quota is 0).
   *   2. If history is empty, do nothing (quota is not consumed).
   *   3. GameStateTransition last = history.pop();
   *   4. GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
   *   5. For each (to, from) in reversed.moves:
   *        entities.putEntity(to, new Empty());
   *        entities.putEntity(from, entityRecordedInReversedMove);

   *      decrement by 1.

  public void undo()
  {

    {
      return;
    }
    if (getHistory().isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }
    GameStateTransition last = getHistory().pop();
    GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Position> entry : reversed.getMoves().entrySet())
    {
      Position toPos = entry.getKey();
      Position fromPos = entry.getValue();
      Entity entity = getEntities().get(toPos);
      getEntities().put(toPos, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
      getEntities().put(fromPos, entity);
    }
    setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
    if (getUndoQuota() > 0)
    {
      setUndoQuota(getUndoQuota() - 1);
    }
  }

   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Atomically relocates whatever Entity currently sits at `from` to `to`,
   *   leaving the source cell as Empty, and records the move inside the
   *   current GameStateTransition so it can be undone later. This is the
   *   primitive used both for a player walking and for a player pushing a
   *   box (the push issues two moves: player and box).
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Look up entity = entities.getEntity(from). It must not be Empty/Wall.
   *   2. If entities.getEntity(to) is not Empty and not the same entity being
   *      moved (used during push: the box), the move is invalid; abort.
   *   3. entities.putEntity(from, new Empty());
   *      entities.putEntity(to, entity);
   *   4. currentTransition.add(from, to);   // record the swap
   * Related Features:
   *   - GameState.entities
   *   - GameState.currentTransition
   * Related Classes:
   *   Related Classes: EntityMap, Entity, Empty, Box, Player, Position,
   *   GameStateTransition
   * Input:
   *   - from : Position
   *       The source cell currently containing the entity to move. Must be
   *       non-null and within bounds, and must contain a movable entity
   *       (Player or Box).
   *   - to   : Position
   *       The destination cell. Must be non-null, within bounds, and either
   *       Empty or - in the case of pushing a box - already logically emptied
   *       by the calling code.
   * Output:
   *   - void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - from and to are valid in-bounds positions.
   *   - from contains a movable entity (Player or Box).
   *   - to is Empty (for a player move) or will be the trailing cell beyond a
   *     box that is also being moved in the same transition.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - entities reflects the move: from is Empty, to holds the relocated
   *     entity.
   *   - currentTransition.moves records (from -> to) so undo() can revert it.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void move(final Position from, final Position to)
  {
    Entity entity = getEntities().get(from);
    if (entity instanceof Empty || entity instanceof Wall)
    {
      return;
    }
    Entity destEntity = getEntities().get(to);
    if (!(destEntity instanceof Empty) && destEntity != entity)
    {
      return;
    }
    getEntities().put(from, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
    getEntities().put(to, entity);
    if (getCurrentTransition() != null)
    {
      getCurrentTransition().add(from, to);
    }
  }

   * Summary:
   *   Snapshots the current GameStateTransition onto the history stack so it
   *   can be reverted to later by undo(). A checkpoint is recorded when a
   *   box is successfully pushed (the caller, e.g. processAction, invokes

    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Reverts the game state to the most recent checkpoint by popping the
   *   top GameStateTransition off the history stack and applying its
   *   reverse() atomically. A finite undo quota is decremented only when a
   *   checkpoint was actually consumed.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If undoQuota == 0, do nothing (undo is not allowed when quota is 0).
   *   2. If history is empty, do nothing (quota is not consumed).
   *   3. GameStateTransition last = history.pop();
   *   4. GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
   *   5. For each (to, from) in reversed.moves:
   *        entities.putEntity(to, new Empty());
   *        entities.putEntity(from, entityRecordedInReversedMove);
   *   6. currentTransition = new GameStateTransition();
   *   7. If undoQuota == -1 (unlimited), keep it; else if undoQuota > 0,
   *      decrement by 1.
   * Related Features:
   *   - GameState.history
   *   - GameState.currentTransition (reset to empty)
   *   - GameState.undoQuota
   *   - GameState.entities (mutated to reflect the undo)
   * Related Classes:
   *   Related Classes: GameStateTransition, TransitionStack, EntityMap, Empty
   * Input:
   *   - (none)
   * Output:
   *   - void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - undoQuota != 0 (the caller guards against invoking undo() when the
   *     quota is exhausted).
   *   - history contains at least one checkpoint transition, otherwise undo()
   *     is a no-op and the quota is not consumed.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - All entity positions recorded in the popped transition are restored
   *     to their pre-move locations.
   *   - undoQuota is decremented by 1 if it was a positive finite value;
   *     unchanged if it was -1 (unlimited).
   *   - currentTransition is replaced with a fresh empty transition.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void undo()
  {
    if (getUndoQuota() == 0)
    {
      return;
    }
    if (getHistory().isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }
    GameStateTransition last = getHistory().pop();
    GameStateTransition reversed = last.reverse();
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Position> entry : reversed.getMoves().entrySet())
    {
      Position toPos = entry.getKey();
      Position fromPos = entry.getValue();
      Entity entity = getEntities().get(toPos);
      getEntities().put(toPos, Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createEmpty());
      getEntities().put(fromPos, entity);
    }
    setCurrentTransition(Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createGameStateTransition());
    if (getUndoQuota() > 0)
    {
      setUndoQuota(getUndoQuota() - 1);
    }
  }

    });

      result.add(p.getValue());
    }

   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If action is null, return Failed("null action").
   *   2. Switch on the concrete Action subclass:
   *      a. Move (Up/Down/Left/Right):
   *         - Resolve initiator player's current position from
   *           state.getPlayerPositionById(action.initiator).
   *         - Compute target via Move.nextPosition(current).
   *         - If target is out of board bounds, return Failed("out of bounds").
   *         - Get entity at target with state.getEntity(target).
   *         - If entity is a Wall or Player, return Failed("blocked").
   *         - If entity is Empty: state.move(current, target); return Success.
   *         - If entity is a Box:
   *             * Verify Box.getPlayerId() == action.initiator; else
   *               return Failed("not your box").
   *             * Compute beyond = move.nextPosition(target).
   *             * If beyond is out of bounds or state.getEntity(beyond) is not
   *               Empty, return Failed("cannot push").
   *             * Otherwise state.move(current, target) and
   *               state.move(target, beyond) atomically inside one transition;
   *               state.checkpoint() and return Success.
   *      b. Undo: delegate to state.undo(); if a checkpoint was successfully
   *         reverted (a checkpoint existed in history and the quota allowed
   *         it, i.e. quota was -1 unlimited or a positive finite quota),
   *         return Success; else return Failed("no undo available").
   *      c. Exit: set isExitSpecified = true; return Success.
   *      d. InvalidInput: return Failed with the InvalidInput.message (e.g.,
   *         "Invalid input").

   * Related Features:
   *   - AbstractSokobanGame.isExitSpecified (set on Exit)

      final int initiator = move.getInitiator();
      final Position current = state.getPlayerPositionById(initiator);
      if (current == null)

        Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
        failed.setReason("blocked");
        failed.setAction(action);
        return failed;
      }
      final Position target = move.nextPosition(current);

        Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
        failed.setReason("out of bounds");
        failed.setAction(action);
        return failed;
      }
      final Entity entity = state.getEntity(target);
      if (entity instanceof Wall || entity instanceof Player)
      {
        Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
        failed.setReason("blocked");
        failed.setAction(action);
        return failed;
      }
      if (entity instanceof Empty)
      {
        state.move(current, target);
        Success success = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createSuccess();
        success.setAction(action);
        return success;

      if (entity instanceof Box)
      {
        final Box box = (Box) entity;
        if (box.getPlayerId() != initiator)
        {
          Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
          failed.setReason("not your box");
          failed.setAction(action);
          return failed;
        }
        final Position beyond = move.nextPosition(target);
        if (beyond.getX() < 0 || beyond.getX() >= state.getBoardWidth() ||
            beyond.getY() < 0 || beyond.getY() >= state.getBoardHeight())
        {
          Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
          failed.setReason("cannot push");
          failed.setAction(action);
          return failed;
        }
        final Entity beyondEntity = state.getEntity(beyond);
        if (!(beyondEntity instanceof Empty))

          Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
          failed.setReason("cannot push");
          failed.setAction(action);
          return failed;
        }
        state.move(current, target);
        state.move(target, beyond);
        state.checkpoint();
        Success success = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createSuccess();
        success.setAction(action);
        return success;
      }
    }
    else if (action instanceof Undo)
    {
      final int quotaBefore = state.getUndoQuota();
      final int historySizeBefore = state.getHistory().size();
      state.undo();
      final int quotaAfter = state.getUndoQuota();
      final int historySizeAfter = state.getHistory().size();
      final boolean reverted = (historySizeAfter < historySizeBefore) ||
                               (quotaBefore != -1 && quotaAfter < quotaBefore);
      if (reverted)

        failed.setAction(action);
        return failed;
      }
      final Position target = move.nextPosition(current);
      if (target.getX() < 0 || target.getX() >= state.getBoardWidth() ||
          target.getY() < 0 || target.getY() >= state.getBoardHeight())
      {
        Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
        failed.setReason("out of bounds");
        failed.setAction(action);
        return failed;
      }
      final Entity entity = state.getEntity(target);
      if (entity instanceof Wall || entity instanceof Player)
      {
        Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
        failed.setReason("blocked");
        failed.setAction(action);
        return failed;
      }
      if (entity instanceof Empty)
      {
        state.move(current, target);
        Success success = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createSuccess();
        success.setAction(action);
        return success;
      }
      if (entity instanceof Box)
      {
        final Box box = (Box) entity;
        if (box.getPlayerId() != initiator)
        {
          Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
          failed.setReason("not your box");
          failed.setAction(action);
          return failed;
        }
        final Position beyond = move.nextPosition(target);
        if (beyond.getX() < 0 || beyond.getX() >= state.getBoardWidth() ||
            beyond.getY() < 0 || beyond.getY() >= state.getBoardHeight())
        {
          Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
          failed.setReason("cannot push");
          failed.setAction(action);
          return failed;
        }
        final Entity beyondEntity = state.getEntity(beyond);
        if (!(beyondEntity instanceof Empty))
        {
          Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
          failed.setReason("cannot push");
          failed.setAction(action);
          return failed;
        }
        state.move(current, target);
        state.move(target, beyond);
        state.checkpoint();
        Success success = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createSuccess();
        success.setAction(action);
        return success;
      }
    }
    else if (action instanceof Undo)
    {
      final int quotaBefore = state.getUndoQuota();
      final int historySizeBefore = state.getHistory().size();
      state.undo();
      final int quotaAfter = state.getUndoQuota();
      final int historySizeAfter = state.getHistory().size();
      final boolean reverted = (historySizeAfter < historySizeBefore) ||
                               (quotaBefore != -1 && quotaAfter < quotaBefore);
      if (reverted)
      {
        Success success = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createSuccess();
        success.setAction(action);
        return success;
      }
      else
      {
        Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
        failed.setReason("no undo available");
        failed.setAction(action);
        return failed;
      }
    }
    else if (action instanceof Exit)
    {
      setIsExitSpecified(true);
      Success success = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createSuccess();
      success.setAction(action);
      return success;
    }
    else if (action instanceof InvalidInput)
    {
      Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
      failed.setReason(((InvalidInput) action).getMessage());
      failed.setAction(action);
      return failed;
    }

    Failed failed = Pa22Factory.eINSTANCE.createFailed();
    failed.setReason("unknown action");
    failed.setAction(action);
    return failed;
  }
